description: Ricardo's quality AO packet as its paper records the run (Form 072B AO form p1, shop-floor sheet p3, FG inspection / release sheet Form 010 p11): the AO issued with its lot, production recorded, QA/QC checked, and finished goods released by QA, each read from the packet's own machine-read fields (leads cited to the scan). A blank field is unknown, never a no (document_fields: a blank is never zero or a match). The release is due by the packet's own required date. Where the paper and FileMaker disagree is reported as the answer's conflicts (document_fields attests), never resolved; the FM side of the run is the manufacturing_order process.

stages.label: AO issued

stages.label: Production recorded
stages.description: The shop-floor sheet records a production date or a filled quantity.

stages.label: QA/QC checked
stages.description: The shop-floor sheet's QA/QC checked box is initialled.

stages.label: FG released
stages.description: The FG inspection / release sheet carries QA's release date.

due.note: The REQUIRED DATE printed on the AO form (often blank: then no due date is stated).
